default.notes: Apply for a visa in advance at a Ghanaian embassy or high commission; during the December–January season Ghana has run a visa-on-arrival scheme — check gis.gov.gh for the current year's rules.

groups.notes: ECOWAS citizens enter Ghana freely under the Community's free-movement protocol — up to 90 days without a visa.
African Union nationals have entered Ghana visa-free since January 2025 — the permitted stay is set by the immigration officer on arrival, so check the stamp you receive.

GH.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Ghanaian citizens.
